note: Sites used by the T-26 checks. 'landing' sites use the app's pins (public/data/landings.json) and their bundled site windows; the others are custom pins chosen here. Longitudes are east-positive.

shackleton-rim.name: Shackleton rim pin
shackleton-rim.why: On the rim crest of Shackleton (IAU centre 89.67 S 129.78 E, 21 km across): 10.4 km from that centre, 1730 m high.

connecting-ridge.name: Connecting ridge pin
connecting-ridge.why: On the ridge between Shackleton and de Gerlache, 1956 m high; the pin @analysis used.

shackleton-floor.name: Shackleton floor
shackleton-floor.why: IAU centre of Shackleton: permanently shadowed floor.

rim-top.name: Shackleton rim, brightest PGDA pixel
rim-top.why: Brightest pixel of AVGVISIB_85S_060M_201608 on Shackleton's rim (85.46 %).

limb-east.name: East limb pin
limb-east.why: Earth rides the horizon; only the 1.9 km whole-Moon grid is bundled here.

limb-west.name: West limb pin
limb-west.why: Earth rides the horizon; only the 1.9 km whole-Moon grid is bundled here.
